bio: Set up in what was the gardener's house on a historical country estate, this is the trendy restaurant-bar concept of the Düster and Schneider restaurateur and winemaking families. Their tasty modern dishes made with seasonal ingredients are served à la carte or as a set menu. In summer, the terrace shaded by the large trees of the lovely Läublin Park is highly inviting. The name of the restaurant is derived from the regional GuPi wines (Gutedel and Pinot Noir). Tip: Booking advisable....
